scope: Engineering failures from ad hoc smoke/startup; not a formal accuracy evaluation

cases.observation: False refusal despite direct retrieved support; prompt clarified general knowledge vs verified official version.
Out-of-scope model payload mixed a false flag and asserted statements; validator refused it.
Mutually exclusive output schema fixed mixed states; one directly supported question was still falsely refused.
Question-last evidence layout fixed that probe; verbatim generated quotation mismatch was rejected. Final model selects passage IDs; program restores original quotes.
Actual Windows native access violation in Chroma/HNSW get_vectors after full UI imports; final UI delegates index/LLM operations to isolated Python workers.
Pinned ChatPage required selector inputs even for a fixed corpus; supplied a read-only BaseIndex/selector contract without another actual vector index.

Initial UI attempt included a real cross-paragraph numeric/source mismatch and a truncated generation. Final B0 caps generation context to one whole chunk, limits statement length, rejects numeric facts absent from the cited paragraph, and preserves incomplete raw responses.
The preceding backend smoke passed 3+1 before the independent UI surfaced additional failures; retained rather than overwritten or used as final UI proof.
Paragraph numbering inside a short answer was rejected by numeric/source checks. Final source addressing uses one complete chunk.

Constrained JSON string limits still allowed repeated text and mid-sentence endings despite correct IDs. Final model API uses simple ANSWER:/REFUSE: text; application validates and binds the only supplied evidence, rejecting repetitions and incomplete sentences.
